name: Free ambulance transport for Victorian Health Care Card holders
provider: Victorian Department of Families, Fairness and Housing
summary: Health Care Card holders in Victoria get free clinically necessary ambulance transport, so they don't need ambulance membership.
who: Health Care Card holders and their dependents, including spouses listed on the card
how: Where possible, please advise the ambulance paramedic of your concession card number.
catches: Please note that concession benefits only apply to clinically necessary transports.
Your concession card must be valid on the date of travel.
Excludes Health Care Cards for Carer Allowance or Foster Care issued in the child's name.

evidence.quote: Please note that concession benefits only apply to clinically necessary transports.
eligible Victorians holding certain concession cards receive free Clinically Necessary ambulance coverage
